mentions.name: Video Hub App
mentions.description: Video Hub App is a desktop app for browsing local video files through a beautiful interface, with scrub-able thumbnails that show multiple screenshots from each video. A next release (8 years after the initial release) adds minor features and bug fixes; it is available for $5 and also free via the open-source repository.
